name: Shockwave
description: Target yourself: push all adjacent enemies 1 tile back and deal 1 damage.

name: Chain spark
description: Deal 1 damage to an enemy within 2 tiles, plus 1 to each of its neighbors.

name: Chrono snare
description: Poison an enemy within 2 tiles: 1 damage per round for 3 rounds.

name: Rift hop
description: Teleport to an empty tile within 2 steps, across walls. Landing hazards hurt.

name: Petal storm
description: Target yourself: deal 2 damage to every adjacent enemy.

name: Clockwork dart
description: Deal 1 damage in a clear straight line within 3 tiles. Free; all copies recharge for 2 rounds.

name: Dew of dawn
description: Restore 3 HP to yourself or a living ally.

name: Ember forge
description: Target yourself: permanently upgrade an Iron edge, Light lance, Step II, or Aegis in your deck.

name: Pierce
description: Deal 2 damage to all enemies in a straight line up to 3 tiles.

name: Time rewind
description: Target self: restore 1 play this turn and remove 1 negative status.

name: Decoy
description: Deploy a decoy dummy with 2 HP up to 2 tiles away. Enemies target it if closer.

name: Iron edge+
description: Deal 3 damage to an adjacent enemy. Forged for this expedition.

name: Light lance+
description: Deal 3 damage in a straight line, up to 3 tiles away. Forged for this expedition.

name: Step III
description: Move up to 3 tiles in a straight line.

name: Aegis+
description: Block up to 2 hits. Target yourself or a living ally.

name: Step I
description: Move 1 tile in a straight line.

name: Step II
description: Move up to 2 tiles in a straight line.

name: Phase dash
description: Move up to 3 tiles. Pass through enemies and allies.

name: Slipstream
description: Swap with an adjacent tile or any living ally. Hazards still hurt.

name: Iron edge
description: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent enemy.

name: Light lance
description: Deal 2 damage in a straight line, up to 2 tiles away.

name: Aegis
description: Block the next hit. Target yourself or a living ally.

name: Second chance
description: Replace your remaining hand. Costs no play.

name: Borrowed time
description: Give an ally one extra play on their next turn.

name: Challenge
description: Redirect one enemy’s announced attack to your current tile.
